title: Simple Decoys
description: This pack adds decoys that you can craft and customize
body:
# This pack adds decoys that you can craft and customize
 [​1.21.9 Pre Release ONLY] (for now)


Features:
You can craft a decoy by using the recipe shown in the image gallery.
When used, a decoy will spawn with your name.
Decoys last for 5 minutes, and can be resummoned infinitely with a 10-second cooldown.
You can rename the decoy egg to whatever you want, and it will use the skin of whoever that name belongs to.

Decoys will mirror both the player's pose and equipment except for the mainhand slot.


**If you plan to feature this pack in any media or server/realm activities, I only ask that you credit me in some way.**

If you have suggestions or feedback, please share so I can improve this pack. Thank you.
